text_to_image_prompt:
East Asian man with messy warm blond short hair, light playful confident charm, fitted charcoal tee and tiny silver ear stud. Facial features: square-oval face, strong cheek width, softly curved brows, rounded slightly wide-set brown eyes, broad short nose with subtle tip definition, small cupid-bow mouth, medium warm complexion.

Create one photorealistic head-and-upper-shoulders character turnaround sheet of this one fictional adult man, landscape approximately 9:4. Exactly three equally spaced matching views in a horizontal row: left true straight-on frontal direct gaze, center exact 90-degree profile with nose toward image right, right symmetric true 180-degree rear view with no face visible. Camera at eye level, upright neutral head, relaxed closed lips, complete hair silhouette and small white headroom. Same head magnification, crown level, identity, hair color and texture, accessories and clothing across all views. Natural adult cranial shape and balanced head-neck-shoulder proportions. Seamless opaque pure white background, bright soft balanced studio lighting, minimal shadows, natural skin pores and fine hair detail, subtle halation, 50mm perspective, gently shallow depth of field with face and hair crisp. No text, labels, borders, watermark, hands, props or full body. Rear hairstyle: naturally elongated lower occipital hair mass, softly tapered hairline extending slightly down the nape, cohesive hair density and realistic texture, balanced exposed neck length and head-to-shoulder ratio.
original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the EDIT TARGET: an approved three-view character sheet. Make a localized proportion correction to the RIGHTMOST REAR-VIEW PANEL ONLY.
The back of the head currently feels vertically too short/small relative to the shoulders. Extend the lower occipital hair mass downward with anatomically believable fullness; lower the bottom nape hairline by approximately 40–55 pixels on this 1881x836 canvas (about 8–11% of current hair height). Keep crown top height and overall width nearly fixed; smoothly continue the existing hair direction and texture from the lower back of the skull into a soft natural tapered nape. This should visibly lengthen the rear head silhouette and reduce exposed upper neck, producing an elegant natural adult head-to-neck-to-shoulder proportion. Do not merely add isolated long wisps. Modestly refine shoulder/neck transition only if necessary, without narrowing unnaturally. Match the believable cranial proportions of the front/profile images. Keep a realistic short/medium haircut, NOT a mullet, long hairstyle, wig, swollen skull, or stretched pixels.
STRICT INVARIANTS: preserve the LEFT frontal panel and MIDDLE exact profile panel as faithfully and unchanged as possible: same face, facial proportions, expression, hairstyle, clothing, skin texture, size, positions. Preserve the same fictional adult man's identity. Right panel remains a symmetric true 180-degree rear view. Preserve hair color, individual haircut and strand/curl character, accessories, clothing, pure white background, bright soft studio light, natural photorealism. No labels, borders, text or extra views.
Output the complete three-panel sheet at exactly the original 1881x836 canvas, 9:4 horizontal ratio. Change only the localized rear head/nape proportions, no restyling or global reframing. Preserve golden blond hair with darker roots and the natural short tapered layered haircut.
